related.title: The Update Framework：更新新鮮度與角色分權
related.titleEn: The Update Framework: freshness and separated update roles
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付四步布局、三條交接證據、斷鏈案例與修復後的可重跑驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the four-step layout, three handoff records, broken-chain case and repeatable repaired verification.
related.difference: 分開root、targets、snapshot、timestamp責任，對過期、回退與不符大小的資料明確拒絕。
related.differenceEn: Separate root, targets, snapshot and timestamp responsibilities; explicitly reject expired, rolled-back and size-mismatched metadata.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 鏈結完整率=有完整摘要交接的邊/必要交接邊；每步存在紀錄仍可能在交接處斷鏈。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 四步流程有3條必要交接，只有2條摘要相符；封裝引用了另一版本測試產物。 完整率2/3=66.6667%；即使四步都標成功仍不能發布。
新鮮度剩餘=到期時間−固定驗證起點；同一次更新應使用一致起點，不能逐步延後使過期資料續命。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成timestamp在12:00到期，驗證起點為09:30；root要求3把授權金鑰中至少2把有效簽署。 新鮮度剩餘2.5小時=150分鐘；有效簽署2把恰好達門檻。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Handoff completeness is evidenced edges divided by required edges; individual step records do not guarantee connected handoffs. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Four steps require three handoffs; only two match because packaging references a different tested product. Completeness is 2/3=66.6667%; four successful step labels still cannot justify release.

Remaining freshness equals expiry minus a fixed update-start time; use one start time throughout an update. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic timestamp expires at 12:00 with validation beginning at 09:30; root requires two valid signatures among three authorized keys. Remaining freshness is 2.5 hours=150 minutes; two valid signatures exactly meet the threshold.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Kyverno：稽核先行的政策推出
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付四步布局、三條交接證據、斷鏈案例與修復後的可重跑驗證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver the four-step layout, three handoff records, broken-chain case and repeatable repaired verification.
related.difference: 固定政策API版本，將要求標籤、拒絕條件、既存資源掃描與新請求行為分開測試。
related.differenceEn: Pin the policy API version and separately test required labels, rejection conditions, existing-resource scans and new requests.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 鏈結完整率=有完整摘要交接的邊/必要交接邊；每步存在紀錄仍可能在交接處斷鏈。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 四步流程有3條必要交接，只有2條摘要相符；封裝引用了另一版本測試產物。 完整率2/3=66.6667%；即使四步都標成功仍不能發布。
違規比例=違規的適用物件/已評估適用物件；Audit記錄違規通常不等於拒絕請求。 以下為自編合成案例，只在自己的離線文件、測試資料或明確授權的隔離環境演練；不是產品實測或生產設定。 合成命名空間有50個適用物件，10個缺少team標籤；政策先以稽核方式觀察。 違規率10/50=20%，通過率80%。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Handoff completeness is evidenced edges divided by required edges; individual step records do not guarantee connected handoffs. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. Four steps require three handoffs; only two match because packaging references a different tested product. Completeness is 2/3=66.6667%; four successful step labels still cannot justify release.

Violation rate uses evaluated applicable objects; Audit recording does not itself mean admission rejection. This original synthetic case uses owned offline files, test data or an explicitly authorized isolated lab; it is not a product benchmark or a production configuration. A synthetic namespace has fifty applicable objects, ten lacking a team label; start in audit mode. Violation rate=10/50=20%, with 80% passing.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
